Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott

Class OttPagesController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott.OttPagesController
All Implemented Interfaces:
OneTimeTokenPageApi
@Controller public class OttPagesController extends Object implements OneTimeTokenPageApi
Serves the two pages of the one-time token flow, as the contract apis/auth-server/web-pages/ auth-server-pages-v1.yaml describes them through the generated OneTimeTokenPageApi: the page where the code is entered (or that says to check the inbox when a magic link was requested) and the page a magic link opens, whose button posts the token. What the first one shows comes from the pending token of the session (see PendingOtt), so it is the same page whatever identifier was typed.

    • ottConfirmPage

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> ottConfirmPage(String token)
      Renders the page a magic link opens. It is never cached and a browser sends no referrer from it, because the token is in its address.
      Specified by:
      ottConfirmPage in interface OneTimeTokenPageApi
      Parameters:
      token - the token of the link, which is only posted back, never checked here.
      Returns:
      the confirmation page.
